## Activity

During November 2025, Central Eye Clinic recorded 188 image captures. Capture sessions ran as planned, with the exception of routine leave. Activity was completed through the usual site arrangements, and no additional operational issue was identified in the reporting information.

The total capture figure provides the activity level for the month and is used as the basis for the image quality and grading results reported below.

## Image quality

Of the 188 captures, 3 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 1.6. The result indicates that most images were suitable for assessment. The ungradable images remain included in the monthly activity total but were not available for grading.

## Grading

Grading identified 63 referable results. The median lag from image capture to completion of grading was 2. This provides the central measure of reporting timeliness for the month. Results requiring referral were identified through the grading process, while the ungradable images were recorded separately under image quality.
